definition: Relational abnormality representation (no external data): the patient's contralesional hemisphere is the reference. Vector = primary-set (core) ipsilesional-minus-contralesional differences at node, edge and network level for every band (rel_IC_*; NaN for subjects with uncertain lesion side), plus the frame-invariant absolute versions (rel_abs_*; all subjects, the absolute L/R version used for uncertain-side subjects).

summaries.mean_abs_<level>: mean over all bands and elements of the primary-set absolute differences at that level (node, edge, network)
summaries.ext_mean_abs_<level>: same for the secondary (extended) set, descriptive
summaries.overall_magnitude_unscaled: mean of the three primary-set level summaries without scaling (descriptive only). The registered overall magnitude = mean of the three level summaries after z-scoring each column within the training folds, computed in Step 8 inside cross-validation.
